headers.//: Anatomy data is immutable — the atlas is a fixed release of BodyParts3D and these filenames never change content. Without this, every visitor revalidates 58 MB of geometry on every load. One year, immutable, is the whole point of shipping versioned data.
Vite already content-hashes these, so a changed build gets a new URL.
The shell must never be cached, or a deploy ships new assets that the stale HTML never references.
This app renders only its own data and takes no user input that reaches a server. Lock the frame ancestry down so it cannot be embedded elsewhere, except by the HMS origin that is meant to embed it.
